provenance.evidence_kind_note: economic model results; not validation evidence. No experimental validation exists.

fx_note: Reference scenario rate (ECB 20 Nov 2026). The 1.2801 SGD/USD of research/data/catalyst_prices.json is superseded for conversion; its SGD values are kept as price_file_SGD_per_kg_superseded_fx.
evidence_grade_note: No grade A (quotation) or B (catalogue) price exists for any ammonia-cracking catalyst. Metal part grade E, non-metal part grade C-derived. 'low' is a metal-content floor.
